connectAiClient.title: Connect an AI client
connectAiClient.description: Let Claude Desktop, Cursor or another MCP client ask about your finances. It gets a token of its own: it can read the same data you can see, including your private accounts, and it never changes anything itself.
connectAiClient.endpoint-hint: The client sends a personal API token with the mcp:read scope (and mcp:propose, if you allow proposals) in an Authorization header. A browser session cookie is never accepted here.
connectAiClient.copy-failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
connectAiClient.allow-proposals: Let the client propose changes for me to confirm
connectAiClient.allow-proposals-hint: The client can suggest categories, mark transactions reviewed or change a note. Each suggestion waits in Settings › Assistant › Pending changes until you apply or dismiss it.
connectAiClient.totp-hint: Only needed if you use two-factor authentication.
connectAiClient.token-created-description: Copy it now and paste it into the client config below. It is stored only as a hash, so this is the only time it is shown.
connectAiClient.config-description: Paste the token where the example shows YOUR_TOKEN. The first block is for Claude Desktop, which bridges remote servers with mcp-remote; the second is the direct HTTP form used by Cursor and other clients.
connectAiClient.calls-description: Every tool an MCP client calls is recorded with its name and time. Amounts and descriptions are never written to the log.
connectAiClient.calls-empty: No AI client has called the server yet.
connectAiClient.error-create: Could not create the token. Try again.
connectAiClient.error-totp-required: Enter your authenticator code to create a token.
connectAiClient.error-invalid-totp: That authenticator code is not valid.
connectAiClient.error-session-not-fresh: Please sign in again before creating a token.
connectAiClient.oauth-description: ChatGPT and other clients that sign in with OAuth need no token: you sign in and allow them once, and they read with the same access you have. They can never change anything.
connectAiClient.oauth-chatgpt-steps: In ChatGPT, add an app (connector) with the MCP endpoint {endpoint} and choose OAuth. ChatGPT sends you here to sign in and allow it.
connectAiClient.oauth-empty: No client is connected with OAuth.
connectAiClient.oauth-revoke-description: {name} loses access at once. To use it again, connect it again from the client.
connectAiClient.oauth-error-revoke: Could not disconnect the client. Try again.
connectAiClient.oauth-off-note: OAuth is turned off on this server, so these clients can no longer connect. You can still disconnect them.

oauthConsent.title: {client} wants to read your finances on {instanceName}
oauthConsent.title-unnamed: An AI client wants to read your finances on {instanceName}
oauthConsent.household-alone: Your household: what you see in the app, including your private accounts.
oauthConsent.household-with: Your household with {members}: what you see in the app, including your private accounts. A member's private account stays hidden unless they shared it with you.

scope.read: Read your accounts and balances, transactions, budgets, goals, net worth and investments.
scope.offline: Stay connected until you disconnect it, without asking you again.

oauthConsent.never-writes: It cannot change, add or delete anything.
oauthConsent.scope-unknown: It also asks for access this server does not grant: {scopes}.
oauthConsent.revoke-hint: You can disconnect it at any time in Settings › API tokens › Connect an AI client.
oauthConsent.invalid-title: This is not a valid connection request
oauthConsent.invalid-body: Start again from the AI client you want to connect.
oauthConsent.error-generic: This request could not be completed. It may have expired: start again from the client.
oauthConsent.redirect-web: When you answer, you go back to {origin}. Continue only if you started this there.
oauthConsent.redirect-device: When you answer, you go back to an app on this device ({app}).
oauthConsent.redirect-device-warning: Any app on this device could claim that address. Continue only if you started this from an app you trust.
oauthConsent.totp-hint: Your account uses two-factor authentication: enter the code from your authenticator app.
oauthConsent.stale-title: Sign in again to connect a client
oauthConsent.stale-body: Connecting a client gives it lasting access, so it needs a sign-in from the last 24 hours.
oauthConsent.error-totp-required: Enter your authenticator code to allow it.
oauthConsent.error-invalid-totp: That authenticator code is not valid.
